name: 03470 · Winchester, NH
findings: ZIP 03470 (Winchester) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 03470 (Winchester) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 03470 (Winchester) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
